item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:15 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas, Bongabong), #Romblon(Ferrol, Odiongan, SantaMaria, SanFernando, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Calatrava, Corcuera, Banton and Concepcion) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(SanJose, SantaFe, Looc and Alcantara) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
